Admission
Courses
In addition to the existing program requirements, students who opt for the Molecular Medicine concentration are required to:
MPhil
Take LIFS 6660 as part of required coursework.
Conduct research in the area of molecular medicine.
PhD
Take LIFS 5260 and LIFS 6660 as part of required coursework.
Conduct research in the area of molecular medicine.
For details please refer to MPhil/PhD Programs in Life Science.
